scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/main typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/preload typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/renderer typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/shared test && bun run --cwd packages/main test && bun run --cwd packages/preload test && bun run --cwd packages/renderer test
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/shared build 2>/dev/null; bun run --cwd packages/preload build && bun run --cwd packages/renderer build && bun run --cwd packages/main build
scripts.clean: find . -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -type d -name 'dist' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'node_modules' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.package:all: bun run worker:publish && bun run --cwd packages/preload build && bun run --cwd packages/renderer build && bun run --cwd packages/main build
